summary: Full E2E test of new 3D Blackjack module (/api/blackjack3d/* + /blackjack3d page). 13/13 backend pytest tests pass (presets, start round + deduction, insufficient points 400, stand/hit/double/surrender actions, SHA-256 commit/reveal, deterministic shoe rebuild, basic-strategy hint, wallet integration, legacy 2D endpoint regression, page render). Frontend Playwright run on live preview URL confirmed: login splash → login form → balance pill (4800 → 4770 pts) → Deal → 3D cards + action bar → Stand → result overlay (HÄVIÖ, Netto -100 pts) → Verify Fairness modal showing commit hash, revealed seed, and client-side SHA-256 check 'Vahvistus onnistui'. Integration with existing SQLite players.points wallet is correct: bal_after == bal_before + net for every settled round.

issues: Inline server-seed/commit-hash textareas overflow horizontally on narrow viewports — not blocking but could wrap.

action_items: (Optional) data-testid naming in review_request differs from actual implementation: spec said 'bj3d-login-password / bj3d-login-submit / bj3d-deal-button / bj3d-action-stand / bj3d-action-hit' but code uses 'bj3d-login-pw / bj3d-login-btn / bj3d-deal-btn / bj3d-act-stand / bj3d-act-hit'. Either update the spec or rename for consistency.

(Optional) 'bj3d-player-hand-0' element exists but textContent is empty in some cases — the visible 'Käsi : 15 (pehmeä) (100pts)' badge is rendered, just verify which element the testid is attached to.
critical_code_review_comments: blackjack3d.py: round_start has redundant BJ resolution branch (lines ~586-597) that could double-credit player_bj when dealer_peek=True and up-card is non-ten/ace — confirmed by code-trace it doesn't, but the control-flow is fragile; recommend collapsing the two `if status == 'active'` blocks into one explicit branch table.
Provably-fair RNG is solid: HMAC-SHA256 byte stream + rejection-sampled uint32 Fisher-Yates. Deterministic shoe verified end-to-end (test_deterministic_shoe_reproduces_initial_cards).
Wallet integration uses _atomic_deduct_points/_add_points from app.py — re-uses existing point_transactions audit, no schema changes to legacy players table. Good.
Migration is idempotent (CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS) and runs only on register() — safe.
test_credentials: Used seeded player BJ3D Test / pw test123 / player_id 1 (4800 pts starting). After this run player balance ~4570 pts due to lost test rounds.
seed_data_creation: No new seed data created; relied on existing player_id=1.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend test file /app/backend/tests/test_blackjack3d.py runs in <3s and is idempotent. It includes a deterministic-shoe verifier that rebuilds the shoe in pure Python from (server_seed, client_seed, nonce, decks) and matches the first 4 dealt cards. If running again, top-up player 1 to >=200 pts to allow all rounds. Frontend test-id prefix is 'bj3d-' but uses abbreviations: -pw, -btn, -act-stand, -fair-* (see /app/templates/blackjack3d.html).
